turns.question: How do we start?
turns.text:
We start by learning your organisation, brand, audiences, internal team, tech and recurring needs so we understand where you’re coming from and what success looks like. 

If you already have history with us, we use existing context; otherwise we run stakeholder interviews, audience definition, communication objectives and reviews to map problems, outcomes and proof points. 

If you want the exact first deliverable or timeline we use, we don’t publish that here — see /expertise/embedded-creative-digital-services for our approach and /expertise/sales-marketing-investor-communications for planning steps.

What we do next depends on your goals: for technical B2B or expert-led companies we clarify the problem your audience recognises, the outcome they care about, the difference you offer and the evidence they need; for sales, marketing or investor work we run stakeholder interviews, audience definition, message hierarchy and proof‑point planning. 

If you want a specific first step for your project, tell us which page of work you’re after: /expertise/embedded-creative-digital-services or /who-we-help/technical-b2b--expert-led-companies or /expertise/sales-marketing-investor-communications.

turns.text:

We focused the work on a single idea — show money moving at speed and scale — and translated that into reusable rules: interaction prototypes, Figma style‑guide documentation, animated graphics, and templates so the system could be implemented consistently in production. 

We don’t publish project timelines, team members, or budget details here. For that information see /works/interchecks.
